encoding.fieldElement: BN254 scalar field element, serialized as a 32-byte big-endian value
encoding.order: Declaration order of `pub` parameters in noir/zkc_kyc_v3/src/main.nr main(); arrays are flattened element-wise
encoding.integers: Unsigned integers are zero-extended into a single field element
encoding.byteArrays: [u8; N] occupies N field elements, one byte per element, in array order

publicInputs.name: presentation_pseudonym
publicInputs.description: H("zkc/presentation-scope:v1", cbk, scopeId), or 0 under the anonymous profile

publicInputs.name: claim_binding
publicInputs.description: Claim binding over (requiredLevel, requiredAttributeHash, proofContext, timestamp)

publicInputs.name: proof_context
publicInputs.description: Deployment/profile-defined replay context hash; MUST be non-zero

publicInputs.name: accumulator_root
publicInputs.description: Issuer-published Poseidon2 Merkle non-revocation accumulator root

publicInputs.name: accumulator_epoch
publicInputs.description: Epoch of the accumulator root used by the witness

publicInputs.name: timestamp
publicInputs.description: Proof freshness timestamp bound into the claim binding; MUST be non-zero

publicInputs.name: current_epoch
publicInputs.description: Verifier-supplied current accumulator epoch; lag above MAX_EPOCH_LAG (10) rejects

publicInputs.name: issuer_public_key_x
publicInputs.description: Trusted issuer secp256k1 public key x-coordinate, big-endian bytes

publicInputs.name: issuer_public_key_y
publicInputs.description: Trusted issuer secp256k1 public key y-coordinate, big-endian bytes
